scene_summary: A fragmented photographic portrait floats on a nearly black violet field. Side-swept hair and repeated eyes dissolve into long pink vertical streaks above detached pale-blue collar points. An expansive red-orange patterned shoulder balances the face, with separate ribbed fabric, a banded translucent veil, an angular cuff aperture and a curled illustrated lining. Purple haze connects the fragments. The treatment is expressionist, but the number of detached pieces makes the composition more elaborate than minimal.
usable_surfaces: Hair-and-eye fragment with descending pink erasure
Red-orange wash across patterned shoulder folds
Angular cuff with brown fold and wine-red interior
Curled dark lining with figures and bright dots

detected_objects.label: Rounded hair-and-eye fragment trailing vertically erased pink flesh
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A dark rounded mass of swept hair frames pale photographic eyes, including a displaced repeated eye at the right. Pink facial pigment extends downward in ragged narrow streaks; the lower face is erased rather than intact. The contour excludes the separate collar points.

detected_objects.label: Broad red-orange patterned shoulder with continuous wash across folds
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The large right-hand garment fragment has a pointed upper fold, curled outer edge and paisley-like pattern. Rust-red and orange pigment continues across its differently oriented planes. Its lower boundary is separated from the dark illustrated lining below.

detected_objects.label: Stepped pale-blue shirt pleat with narrow ribs and mottled edges
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Above and to the right of the face sits an isolated folded strip with repeated vertical pale-blue ribs. Its upper edge steps downward, its lower edge breaks into unequal lengths, and brown mottling marks the left margins.

detected_objects.label: Translucent frayed veil carrying blue, purple, rust and navy bands
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The detached upper-right fabric has irregular frayed edges and softly wavy horizontal bands: blue along the top, violet through the middle, a thin rust band, and deep navy below. The mapped surface excludes the loose haze beneath it.

detected_objects.label: Pale angular cuff enclosing a brown fold and wine-red shadow
detected_objects.visual_evidence: An isolated hollow folded form near the lower center has sharp pale-blue outer planes surrounding a dark aperture. A triangular brown inner fold and deep wine-red lower interior are plainly visible. It is physically separate from the portrait collar.

detected_objects.label: Curled dark lining flap with illustrated figures, white dots and colored flecks
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The bottom-right flap curls forward with a pale stitched-looking rim. Its dark surface contains small faces and figures, conspicuous round white dots, and scattered red and blue accents. This is distinct from the orange shoulder and from the isolated white fragment.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Visual estimates: the face and orange shoulder dominate, while the banded veil forms a third substantial region. Dark gaps keep the mapped fragments distinguishable, but extra patterned scraps, detached collars and connecting violet haze make this a detailed expressionist assemblage rather than a minimal plate. Coverage is approximate, not a measured mask union.
